links.text:
‼️ Amazon says an attacker tried to exploit PHP2Shell four days before PHP disclosed the two flaws.

Its MadPot honeypots logged it on 17 October from an anonymisation network, while the bugs were under embargo.

Nobody knows how the attacker got the exploit details.
